title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Billing Guideline: Monthly Tuition Posting, Rate Basis and First-Month Proration
content:
**1. Posting.** Each billing month's tuition posts on the tuition posting day for every Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment in status active or suspended for nonpayment. The first month's tuition, for the billing month of the start date, posts on the day the seat is confirmed. Tuition charges post only to an enrollment in status active or suspended for nonpayment; the program's own enrollment record is the evidence of that status.

**2. Starting point.** The starting point is the standard monthly tuition of the enrollment's plan.

**3. Rate basis.** The rate basis is decided once per billing month from the records on the posting date:

- the **free-meal rate** when the student's School Nutrition meal account holds any Free Meal Status tier, Prior-Year Carryover included;
- the **reduced-meal rate** when it holds any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier;
- the **employee rate** when the household profile is flagged as a district employee household;
- the **standard rate** otherwise.

When more than one applies, the rate basis with the largest discount is used. Rate-basis discounts never add together.

**4. Sibling discount.** The sibling discount for the child's sibling position then applies to the amount after the rate-basis discount.

**5. Proration.** A first month whose start date falls on or after the half-month start day is billed at the half-month rate of the discounted amount. Every other month is a full month, including a month in which care ends.

**6. Rounding.** The amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

**7. Changes during a month.** A School Nutrition status change recorded during a month affects the next posting, never a tuition charge already posted. A plan change is billed at the new plan's standard monthly tuition from the billing month of its effective date. An enrollment funded through Workforce Solutions Child Care Services is billed under the program's Workforce Solutions Child Care Services funding terms.

## Figures by plan

| Plan | Free-meal rate discount | Reduced-meal rate discount | Employee rate discount | Tuition posting day | Half-month start day | Half-month rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| All six Creek Kids Club plans | 50 percent | 25 percent | 20 percent | day 1 of the billing month | day 16 | 50 percent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Take a plan with a hypothetical standard tuition of 200.00, a student with a Reduced-Price Meal Status on the posting date, sibling position 2, and a first month starting on the 20th:

- The reduced-meal rate discount of 25 percent gives 150.00.
- The sibling discount of 10 percent acts on 150.00 and gives 135.00.
- The start falls on or after day 16, so the month is billed at 50 percent of 135.00, which is 67.50.

If the same household were also an employee household, the reduced-meal rate (25 percent) would still be used, because it is the largest single rate-basis discount; the 20 percent employee rate is not added to it. A start on day 15 is billed as a full month, and a start on day 16 is billed at half.
